title: Bank Nifty crosses 61,000, closes in on record high; further gains hinge on 61,400 breakout
summary: The banking index has gained around 12% in November, supported by renewed foreign investor buying, gains in public sector bank stocks and easing concerns over crude oil prices. A decisive move above 61,400 could take it to a new high, while failure to clear that hurdle may trigger consolidation.
